meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for Carpet Cleaning
meta_description: Honest carpet cleaning in London and Essex: stains pre treated, hot water extraction, before and after photos, price agreed upfront and a 24 hour re clean.
h1: Carpets cleaned properly, with nothing hidden
intro: Maybe it's a red wine mark from last weekend, a hallway that's slowly gone grey, or a rented flat you need to hand back looking right. Whatever brought you here, you want three things: the stain dealt with honestly, a carpet that isn't damp for days, and a price agreed before we start, with anything extra explained and confirmed with you first.

understand.heading: The worries behind a carpet booking
paragraphs: Carpet cleaning feels like a gamble to a lot of people. Some have hired a machine before and ended up with a soggy, patchy carpet that smelled worse than when they started. Others have been promised that every mark would vanish, and then watched the old coffee stain come straight back once it dried.

It's usually tied to something bigger, too: moving out, a baby about to start crawling, a pet that's had an accident, or family coming to stay. You need it done once, done well, and dry enough to walk on within a few hours.
So we're straight with you from the start. We tell you what we expect a stain to do before we treat it, we explain how long drying really takes, and we show you the result in photos.

different.heading: What we do differently, and why it matters to you

items.title: Hot water extraction with professional equipment
items.text: We use proper extraction machines that rinse dirt out from deep in the fibres and pull the water back up, rather than leaving it to soak into the underlay.

items.title: Stains treated before anything else
items.text: Visible stains are pre treated individually before the full clean, so each one gets its own attention instead of simply being run over with the rest.

items.title: An honest view of old stains
items.text: Very old or previously treated stains may not lift completely. We'll tell you that before we start, not as we're packing up.

items.title: A fast dry method
items.text: Most carpets can be walked on within a few hours, with full drying up to 24 hours depending on the carpet and how well the room is ventilated.

items.title: Priced by room and agreed upfront
items.text: Carpet cleaning starts from £49 per room. You choose rooms, stairs and rugs in the booking form and see the exact price before you confirm.

items.title: Before and after photos
items.text: Our cleaners photograph the carpets before and after, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. It's a useful record for tenants and landlords alike.

steps.title: Get your price
steps.text: Click Get a quote, choose the rooms, stairs and rugs you need cleaned, and see the exact price before you book.

steps.title: Clear the floor
steps.text: Move small items, toys, shoes and anything fragile off the carpet. Tell us about heavy furniture when you book and we'll confirm what we can do around it.

steps.title: Inspection and preparation
steps.text: We check the carpet type and condition, take the before photos, vacuum up loose dirt and pre treat visible stains.

steps.title: The deep clean
steps.text: Hot water extraction across the whole carpet area, an odour neutralising treatment, then the pile is groomed so it dries evenly and looks right.

steps.title: Drying and your photos
steps.text: We use our fast dry method and can place furniture pads to protect the carpet while it dries. Your after photos follow in the same private link.

promise.heading: If you're not happy, we come back
paragraphs: If you're not happy with any part of the carpet clean, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean it free of charge.

Your price is agreed before you book. If a carpet turns out to be heavily soiled and needs extra treatment time, we'll explain why and confirm the cost with you before any extra work starts, never after. And the person in your home is always one of our own trained, insured and DBS checked team, never a subcontractor.

proof.heading: Where our carpet experience comes from
proof.paragraph: We've been cleaning homes in London and Essex for 12 years, and for four of those years about 95% of our bookings were end of tenancy cleans. Carpets are one of the first things checked when a tenancy ends, so we've learned what a carpet needs to look right at inspection and, just as importantly, what it's realistic to promise. With 7,549 end of tenancy cleans behind us, a tired lounge carpet doesn't faze us. SN Cleaning Services is based at 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood, and these are real Google reviews from our customers.

faqs.question: What will I pay to have one room cleaned?
faqs.answer: Carpet cleaning starts from £49 per room. Stairs, rugs and extra rooms are added in the booking form, which shows your exact price before you confirm. If a carpet is heavily soiled and needs extra treatment, we'll confirm that with you before starting.

faqs.question: Do you clean stairs and rugs as well as rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Stairs and rugs can be added in the booking form alongside your rooms, or booked with just one room. Tell us roughly how many stairs there are and the size of each rug so the price reflects exactly what you need.

faqs.question: Which cleaning method do you use?
faqs.answer: Hot water extraction with professional equipment, which rinses dirt from deep in the fibres and draws the water back out. Occasionally a dry clean suits a carpet better, and we'll choose the right method after checking its type and condition.

faqs.question: When can I put my furniture back?
faqs.answer: Ideally once the carpet is fully dry, which can take up to 24 hours depending on the carpet and ventilation. If you need furniture back sooner, ask for furniture pads, which we can place under legs to protect the carpet while it dries.

faqs.question: How can I help the carpet dry faster?
faqs.answer: Good airflow makes the biggest difference. Open windows if the weather allows, keep internal doors open and keep foot traffic light for the first few hours. Socks or clean slippers are better than outdoor shoes until the carpet is fully dry.

faqs.question: Do I need to move furniture before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Please clear small items, toys, shoes and anything fragile from the floor. Let us know about large furniture such as wardrobes or sofas when you book, and we'll confirm what can be cleaned around or moved on the day.

faqs.question: Will the carpet smell afterwards?
faqs.answer: We use an odour neutralising treatment that deals with smells at the source rather than covering them with fragrance. Good airflow while the carpet dries helps too. If a smell is particularly strong, mention it when you book so we know what we're dealing with.

faqs.question: Can you deal with pet accidents?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pre treat pet stains and use an odour neutralising treatment that works on the cause of the smell. Fresher accidents usually respond better than old ones, and we'll be honest about what to expect once we've seen the carpet.

faqs.question: Do you clean wool carpets?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're experienced with a wide range of carpet types and ages, including delicate wool weaves. We check each carpet's type and condition before we start and choose the treatment that suits it, rather than using one approach for everything.

faqs.question: How long will the clean take?
faqs.answer: That depends on how many rooms, stairs and rugs you book and the condition of the carpet. Tell us what you need when you get a quote, and if you'd like an idea of timing for your home, ask our team.

faqs.question: Do I need to be at home?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. You can let us in and get on with your day, or leave access instructions when you book. Remember you'll want to keep off the carpet for a few hours afterwards, so plan where you and any pets will be.

faqs.question: Will I get photos of the work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our cleaners photograph the carpets before and after, and you receive a private link with Before and After folders. It's a helpful record, especially when you're moving out of a rented home or checking a property between tenants.

faqs.question: I'm moving out. Will carpet cleaning help with my deposit?
faqs.answer: Carpets are one of the things agents check at the end of a tenancy. A professional clean helps return them to the condition they were in at check in, allowing for fair wear and tear. Many tenants book it alongside our end of tenancy clean, which starts from £179.

faqs.question: Can landlords book carpet cleaning between tenants?
faqs.answer: Yes, we clean carpets in rental properties as well as people's own homes. Give us the access arrangements when you book, and the before and after photos give you a clear record of the carpets' condition for your files.

faqs.question: Are your carpet cleaners insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your carpets are cleaned by our own trained, insured and DBS checked team. SN Cleaning Services never uses subcontractors, so you always know who is coming into your home and who is responsible for the work.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the result?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean the area free of charge. If it's a stain we warned you might not lift fully, we'll talk you through honestly whether anything more can realistically be done.

faqs.question: Could cleaning shrink or damage my carpet?
faqs.answer: We check the carpet's type and condition first and choose the treatment to suit it, which is how we avoid problems. If we have any concern about a particular carpet, we'll tell you before we start rather than take a risk with it.

faqs.question: Can you clean my sofa or mattress on the same visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upholstery cleaning starts from £69 and mattress cleaning from £39. Mention them when you get your quote and we can look at combining carpets, upholstery and mattresses into a single visit, so you only have one day of disruption.

faqs.question: How often should carpets be professionally cleaned?
faqs.answer: It depends on how your home is used. Homes with pets, young children or a busy hallway usually benefit from more frequent cleans than a spare bedroom does. If you're unsure, tell us about your home and we'll give you an honest view.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: You'll see the full price in the booking form before you confirm, along with how payment works. If you have any question about paying, our support team can help Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm and at weekends 8am to 5pm.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or change my booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact our team, who will explain how changes and cancellations work for your booking. Support is open Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm, and Saturday and Sunday 8am to 5pm, and the sooner you tell us, the easier it is to help.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover for carpet cleaning?
faqs.answer: We clean carpets across London and Essex, working from our office in Brentwood. Enter your postcode when you click Get a quote and the form will confirm whether your address is covered.

faqs.question: Do you use strong chemicals on carpets?
faqs.answer: We use professional products suited to the carpet and the stain, and they're safe for pets and children once the carpet is dry. Hot water extraction then rinses dirt out of the fibres and draws the water back up. If anyone at home has sensitivities, mention it when you book.

cta.text: Pick your rooms, see the exact price, and only book if it suits you.
